 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. After a forgettable first half, Como turn up the tempo after the break and score twice in 11 minutes against a Sassuolo side that looked far too lightweight and distracted.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cesc Fabregas' magical spell continues as he rounds off a dream week.
 🙌🏻 A low-key first half
 Como and Sassuolo play at a fairly slow tempo in the first half, but all the most dangerous chances still fall to Como. Douvikas poses the biggest threat, hitting the crossbar and forcing Turati into a close-range save.
 🔥 Douvikas just keeps scoring: 1-0 Como
 Como take the lead in the 49th minute through none other than Tasos Douvikas. The Greek striker already has seven goals this season, four of them in Serie A.
 Kaiki surges down the left and picks out Caqueret's run with a through ball. The midfielder sends a low cross into the middle, and the striker makes no mistake from close range.
 😱 Sassuolo DISASTER, Douvikas bags a brace
 Como double their lead in the 60th minute as Douvikas scores his first brace of the season, producing a carbon copy of his opener for a pair of tap-ins.
 Sassuolo are caught napping as they play out from the back, with Berardi losing the ball far too easily to Kaiki. This time, the full-back provides the assist himself, once again finding the Greek striker unmarked in the six-yard box, and he makes no mistake.
